薰儿：我稳赢的！（薰儿：我稳赢的！（第22页）云韵微微颔首，娇躯微微一震，巨大的青色斗气羽翼从背后弹出。“老师，您这是要走？”萧炎愣了一下。“嗯，去办点事，晚上就回来了，你好好修炼。”云韵笑着伸手揉了一下萧炎的乌黑的头发，叮嘱了一句，旋即便化作一道青色光影，向着远处飞掠而去。萧炎抬手在云韵揉过的地方摸了摸，表情有些怪异。好奇怪的感觉，这算是摸头杀？要知道，即便是他的父亲萧战，也有快三年没有像这样摸过他的头了。“萧炎哥哥，想什么呢？这么入神，以前薰儿一靠近，你就会察觉的。”少女清脆娇俏的声音，带着几分好奇在耳畔响起。刚才云韵揉萧炎头发的一幕，她也看在眼里。但她可不会表现出来任何的异常。“唉，有点想母亲了。”萧炎闻言叹了一口气。自从母亲去世之后，他已经很久没有感受过来自母亲的关怀了，刚才云韵那举动，倒是给了他一种类似的感觉。薰儿闻言也沉默了。她的母亲，因为自身实力太弱，无法承受她的强大血脉，在生下她不久以后，就去世了。然后她就被父亲送来了萧家。遇到了，萧炎哥哥。“薰儿，陪我坐一会儿吧。”说是坐一会儿，但萧炎却是直接躺在了地上，双手枕在脑后。“好。”薰儿在他身边躺了下来，学着他的样子，将双手垫在后脑勺上。她什么也没说。只是静静地陪着萧炎。直到夕阳渐渐落下，萧炎才缓缓开口：“薰儿。”“萧炎哥哥，我在。”她柔声回应道。“对于纳兰嫣然，你怎么看。”落下的夕阳，洒在萧炎的半张脸上，让他的神情显得有些晦暗难明。“要薰儿说真话吗？”薰儿闻言坐起身来，低头看向萧炎，眨眨眼睛。“嗯。”萧炎点点头。“那薰儿可就直说了，我感觉纳兰嫣然对萧炎哥哥似乎有所企图，只是不知道，她所图的，对萧炎哥哥有没有危害。”薰儿歪头想了想，认真说道。“嗯，我们的感觉差不多，休息够了，我们该回去了。”萧炎不置可否地笑了笑，站起身来，伸手拉住薰儿的手，将她从地上拉起，袖袍轻柔地拂过她的衣裙，将杂草扫掉。看着萧炎小心又认真的样子，薰儿的嘴角不由得微微翘起。想要和她抢萧炎哥哥？哪有那么容易！不过…以后对萧炎哥哥的关注必须更多一些了，免得他被其他坏女人抢走！心中虽然思绪纷飞，但薰儿的脸上却不露声色，她伸手拍掉了萧炎身上的杂草，抱住萧炎的手臂，可爱地眨眨眼：“好哦！萧炎哥哥，我们走！”夕阳西下，少年少女相伴而行，晚风吹拂而过，像是一只调皮的精灵，欢快地撩起他们的头发和衣摆，祥和而美好。

Chapter 5 Xun'er I'm sure to win (Page 1)
Xun'er: I'm sure to win! (Xun'er: I'm sure to win! (Page 22) Yun Yun nodded slightly, her delicate body trembled slightly, and huge blue fighting spirit wings popped out from her back. "Teacher, are you leaving?" Xiao Yan was stunned for a moment. "Well, I'm going to do some errands. I'll be back in the evening. You practice well." Yun Yun smiled and stretched out her hand to rub Xiao Yan's black hair, and gave an instruction, which immediately turned into a blue light and shadow, Flying away towards the distance. Xiao Yan raised his hand and touched the place where Yun Yun had rubbed it, with a strange expression. It felt strange, was this a head-touch? You know, even his father, Xiao Zhan, had not touched his head like this for almost three years. "Brother Xiao Yan, what are you thinking about? You would have noticed it when Xun'er came close before." Curiosity sounded in her ears. She also saw the scene where Yun Yun rubbed Xiao Yan's hair. But she didn't show any abnormality. "Oh, I miss my mother a little." He hadn't felt the care from his mother for a long time since his mother passed away. Xun'er was silent when he heard this. Her mother died shortly after giving birth to her because she was too weak. Then she met Brother Xiao Yan. She put her hands on the back of her head. She didn't say anything. She just stayed with Xiao Yan quietly. It wasn't until the sunset that Xiao Yan slowly said, "Xun'er, I'm here." She responded softly. "What do you think of Nalan Yanran?" The setting sun shone on half of Xiao Yan's face, making his expression look a little dark. "Do you want Xun'er to tell the truth?" ?" Xun'er sat up after hearing this, looked down at Xiao Yan, and blinked. "Yeah." Xiao Yan nodded. "Xun'er said it bluntly. I feel that Nalan Yanran seems to have an intention towards brother Xiao Yan, but I don't know if what she intends is harmful to him." "Xiao Yan smiled noncommittally, stood up, stretched out his hand to hold Xun'er's hand, and pulled her up from the ground. His sleeves gently brushed her dress and swept away the weeds. Looking at Xiao Yan's careful and serious look, the corners of Xun'er's mouth couldn't help but curl up slightly. Want to compete with her for Xiao Yan's brother? It's not that easy! But... I must pay more attention to Xiao Yan's brother in the future, lest he be taken over by others. He's a bad woman! Although thoughts were racing in her heart, Xun'er's face remained calm. She reached out and patted the weeds off Xiao Yan's body, hugged Xiao Yan's arm, and winked cutely: "Okay! Brother Xiao Yan, let's go!" As the sun set, the boy and girl walked together, and the evening breeze blew by, like a naughty elf, happily lifting up their hair and clothes, peaceful and beautiful.
